title: Auto satin turns a 90° bend as PE-DESIGN does (Half Stitch off)
description: The round-1 bent band in satin with Auto direction, density 3, without under sewing and with Half Stitch off, must turn its corner as PE-DESIGN 11.50 does: every rung end on the outline, the rung direction turning evenly with the distance along the outer edge over three band widths centred on the outer corner.

featureMatrix.feature: Satin: a zigzag across the column

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/stitches/satin-auto-bend-90-nohalf.pes (under sewing off, density 3, 2026-10-27): 219 stitches; the rung direction turns from 0° to 90° linearly over 15 mm of outer edge centred on the outer corner; the inner ends crowd 0.2–0.3 mm apart near the inner corner; longest 7.0 mm.

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page draw the closed polygon (0,0) (30,0) (30,30) (25,30) (25,5) (0,5) mm. Line Not Sewn; region Satin Stitch, Direction Auto, Half Stitch off, Density 3.0, Under Sewing off, other attributes default. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/stitches/satin-auto-bend-90-nohalf.pes (under sewing off, density 3, 2026-10-27): the longest crossings are in the corner fan.
